g.text: Five native harnesses | same DeepSeek model | pytest-7490
Each dot is one formal run; left-to-right offsets identify blocks 1, 2, 3. Storage and memory axes are logarithmic.
Storage is file growth across workspace, home and /tmp; installation and controller trace storage are excluded.
Missing usage is excluded only from the token panel. Unresolved runs can consume less by failing early.
One public historical task, three runs per harness: these observations do not establish a general ranking.
